title: Haro Files for Bankruptcy After the BMX Brand’s Short Foray Into Drop Bars
content:
Chapter 11 follows a $2.86 million lawsuit from supplier Kenstone, U.S. layoffs, and the brand handing its drop-bar lineup over to Masi in 2025.

Read the full article at Haro Files for Bankruptcy After the BMX Brand’s Short Foray Into Drop Bars on Velo.
author: Logan Jones-Wilkins
